scope: Selected W11 palette data, functional theme/text-role/application and selected button/check/radio/switch/activity/progress/Cupertino and Material sliders, slider theme/value compositions and generated original shape bodies; no whole design library/native/font/asset qualification.
numericPolicy: Generated and finite field-projection Dart annotations retain resolved analyzer provenance. Handwritten TypeScript uses the existing Core ARGB/TextStyle ABI and adds no fictitious Dart annotations. Core IconData.codePoint and its constructor parameter annotations are checked against their exact analyzer-resolved int field/parameter records; generated catalog literal arguments preserve those resolved records.
ownership: Palette/M3 role and typography data: finite AST extraction with edit conflict rejection. Swatch/theme/text-role/App/button/check/radio/switch/progress compositions: explicit functional TypeScript source using shared Core contracts; selected M3 button color decisions are compared with original bodies. Slider data fields are a managed resolved-IR projection and RangeValues/RangeLabels/enums are complete finite body generation; Material Slider/defaults/overlay are finite functional ports on current Core owners. Three original slider/range/value-indicator libraries supply40 complete generated declarations with private helpers; RangeSlider is a finite functional State/Render port with actual two-focus/two-source-node input/overlay ownership. Original range default getters, preferred geometry and callback/selection/semantic decision bodies are compared independently. Tooltip/theme/visibility are explicit source-shaped ports on Core RawTooltip with fifteen theme fields, source duration copy/lerp omissions and actual glyph/semantics/hover/touch/Escape/retirement verification; whole source hierarchy and latest native delivery remain separate. MaterialType is a complete managed resolved-IR enum preserving canonical values/index/name/toString and integer provenance. Material surface/InkFeature/elevation and Ink/InkDecoration/image are finite functional ports on existing physical shape, decoration/image, ticker and render owners; unchanged original build/elevation/circle/decoration bodies are compared independently. InkResponse/InkWell and Highlight/Splash/Ripple/NoSplash are finite functional ports using actual Core gesture/focus/keep-alive/ticker/Material owners. Interactive base clipping and effect bodies/private helpers, selected response callbacks/enable decisions and complete Feedback platform decisions are compared independently with unchanged native Dart bodies. Feedback uses explicit per-View messengers. Material is M3-only: source M3 Sparkle on supported Android uses current RuntimeShader suppliers, otherwise Ripple. M2 selection/factories/defaults are removed. Current emulator/shader receipts qualify their declared scope; broader native delivery remains separate. RefreshProgressIndicator uses actual circular Material, geometry/arrow, opacity/rotation/phase/semantics/ticker ownership. Complete original Refresh widget/State/painter and source progress theme16-field diagnostics/hash equality relations are compared independently; public progress fields are supplied. Host hash values are not native VM hash numbers. Complete8825 Material icon constants and20 adaptive getters are resolved-IR data on Core IconData with the unchanged Google Material icon font and CC BY4.0 notice. ChipThemeData supplies all23 source fields/copy/lerp/equality/hash/diagnostics and actual inherited ChipTheme; ChipAnimationStyle supplies four nullable styles. Native original-body comparisons retain source state-side empty-state interpolation and invalid dual-null resolution. ThemeData supplies canonical Core icon and Material chip data. Checkbox/Radio/Switch theme data supplies all28 source fields, null-retaining copy/non-null empty lerp, numeric generic DartDouble carriers, property/side/shape/padding interpolation and equality/diagnostics. Three inherited themes use source value-based notification and nearest/global lookup. Private M3 defaults have full unchanged finite native source comparisons; original control State/paint/public API and tile wrappers remain separate. RawChip/Chip/Action/Choice/Filter/Input resolved public APIs, complete defaults and functional State/render/input/ink/tooltip/focus/semantics/animation owners are supplied on Core. Complete original private renderer/layout/hit/noncompositing paint and M3 defaults/background methods have independent finite native comparisons. Core AnimatedSwitcher retains keyed outgoing-child fade/layout/controller lifetime. Color/shape-only chip ink adapts the original outlined-border interior inset. Transport-only source semantics ids add no synthetic enabled flag; actual SDK nested DOM buttons dispatch only their owning semantic action. Source constructor assertions are enforced in host modes. Divider/VerticalDivider and DividerThemeData use source build/default/border-selection/copy/lerp/equality/diagnostic contracts on canonical Core Container/Border/InheritedTheme owners, including explicit zero-area hairlines and M3 outlineVariant. Twelve public numeric fields retain resolved analyzer provenance. ThemeData supplies source dividerTheme and M3 dividerColor defaults. Independent unchanged source-body/actual CPU pixel/RN Babel/public archive checks cover this selection. ListTile and its theme supply the resolved source public API and canonical enums, four-slot wet/dry/intrinsic/baseline/RTL/paint/hit decisions, selected M3 defaults, state color/cursor precedence, actual Material/Ink/focus/semantics ownership, source modern merge/wrap omissions, diagnostics and divideTiles. Obsolete ListTileTheme constructor/getter aliases are omitted. The private selected SafeArea composition consumes horizontal safe insets; it does not supply the full public SafeArea/SliverSafeArea API. IconButtonThemeData and inherited theme use the existing finite seven-field ButtonStyle ABI, whose supported field interpolation/equality/hash are supplied; arbitrary source ButtonStyle properties and IconButton widget remain open. Eight ListTile/theme nullable double fields preserve resolved provenance. Full native hierarchy/retained compositor/serialized diagnostics/swipe RefreshIndicator, every-shape paint/font and broader native/physical delivery remain open.
